column1: #source: nine real, unchanged rows across three files in https://github.com/LasseMempel/thesaurusscience (CC BY 4.0), pulled 2026-09 (after Lasse's "Neue Infos" message added Scripts/ and grew Mappings/ to 44 files, ~399k rows): Mappings/dai_aat.sssom.tsv, Mappings/inrap_pactols_sujets_aat.sssom.tsv, Mappings/ads_eh_tmt2_aat.sssom.tsv.

#comment: each triple is a real AAT concept independently exactMatch'd from three different national recording traditions (DAI/Germany, INRAP-Pactols/France, ADS Historic England/UK) that never reference each other directly - no dai<->inrap or dai<->ads mapping file exists in the corpus (checked). Weight = 1.0 for every row: GSAS's real minimal-model exactMatch degree, unchanged - these are curated SSSOM assertions, not raw similarity scores, so no calibration step applies here (contrast with example_calibration.tsv).

#comment_2: found by counting real exactMatch rows into AAT across the ten *_aat.sssom.tsv files used in Lasse's own script: 1,775 rows, 1,431 distinct AAT targets, 227 targets reached from >=2 different source files, 19 from >=3 (these three triples are among those 19).
